course.title: Unit 3 Work and play-Part A--【例句】
course.description: Part A（What do you learn at school?）

sentences.content: What's your favourite day at school, John?
sentences.english: What's your favourite day at school , John ?
sentences.chinese: John，你在学校最喜欢哪一天？

sentences.content: Wednesday.
sentences.english: Wednesday
sentences.chinese: 星期三

sentences.content: What do you have on Wednesdays?
sentences.english: What do you have on Wednesdays ?
sentences.chinese: 你星期三有什么安排？

sentences.content: I have Chinese, maths, music and PE.
sentences.english: I have Chinese , maths , music and PE
sentences.chinese: 我有语文、数学、音乐和体育课。

sentences.content: Maths is not easy.
sentences.english: Maths is not easy
sentences.chinese: 数学并不容易。

sentences.content: No, but I really like my maths teacher!
sentences.english: No , but I really like my maths teacher !
sentences.chinese: 不，但我真的很喜欢我的数学老师！

sentences.content: That's good. Is music your favourite subject?
sentences.english: That's good . Is music your favourite subject ?
sentences.chinese: 那很好。音乐是你最喜欢的科目吗？

sentences.content: Yes. I really like singing. And I like PE too.
sentences.english: Yes . I really like singing . And I like PE too
sentences.chinese: 是的。我真的很喜欢唱歌。我也喜欢体育课。

sentences.content: Great! Wednesday is your favourite day.
sentences.english: Great ! Wednesday is your favourite day
sentences.chinese: 太好了！周三就是你最爱的日子。

sentences.content: But I like Tuesdays and Fridays.
sentences.english: But I like Tuesdays and Fridays
sentences.chinese: 但我喜欢星期二和星期五。

sentences.content: Why?
sentences.english: Why ?
sentences.chinese: 为什么？

sentences.content: Because I have my tajiquan class!
sentences.english: Because I have my tajiquan class !
sentences.chinese: 因为我要上我的太极拳课！

sentences.content: What's your favourite subject?
sentences.english: What's your favourite subject ?
sentences.chinese: 你最喜欢的科目是什么？

sentences.content: Binbin starts a new week of school on Mondays.
sentences.english: Binbin starts a new week of school on Mondays
sentences.chinese: Binbin每周一都开始新一周的学校生活。

wordDetails.definition: start（第三人称单数）: 开始

sentences.content: Tuesday is his favourite day.
sentences.english: Tuesday is his favourite day
sentences.chinese: 周二（星期二）是他最喜欢的一天。

sentences.content: Binbin goes to the Robot Club on Wednesdays after school.
sentences.english: Binbin goes to the Robot Club on Wednesdays after school
sentences.chinese: Binbin每周三放学后去机器人俱乐部。

sentences.content: He has music class on Wednesday and Thursday mornings.
sentences.english: He has music class on Wednesday and Thursday mornings
sentences.chinese: 他每周三和周四上午有音乐课。

wordDetails.definition: have（第三人称单数现在时）: 有

sentences.content: He cleans the classroom with his friends on Friday afternoons.
sentences.english: He cleans the classroom with his friends on Friday afternoons
sentences.chinese: 他每周五下午和朋友一起打扫教室。

wordDetails.definition: clean（第三人称单数）: 清洁

sentences.chinese: 姓名, 最喜欢的一天, 科目与活动

sentences.content: One night, a baker makes some pies.
sentences.english: One night , a baker makes some pies
sentences.chinese: 某个夜晚，一位面包师烤了些馅饼。

sentences.content: He doesn't lie down and works till light.
sentences.english: He doesn't lie down and works till light
sentences.chinese: 他不躺下休息，一直工作到天亮。

wordDetails.definition: work（第三人称单数）: 工作

sentences.content: But he eats all his pies, and his belt is too tight.
sentences.english: But he eats all his pies , and his belt is too tight
sentences.chinese: 但他吃光了所有的派，腰带也勒得太紧了。

sentences.content: It's not right to work and eat all night.
sentences.english: It's not right to work and eat all night
sentences.chinese: 整晚工作加进食可不合适。

sentences.content: I like eating pies.
sentences.english: I like eating pies
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢吃派。

sentences.content: I eat them every night.
sentences.english: I eat them every night
sentences.chinese: 我每晚都吃它们。

sentences.content: It's not right to eat too many pies.
sentences.english: It's not right to eat too many pies
sentences.chinese: 吃太多派是不对的。
